findings.title: Secret key rotation breaks session deserialization
findings.body: The serializer now receives `keys` (a list) instead of `app.secret_key` (a string/bytes) as the first positional argument. The `URLSafeTimedSerializer` constructor expects the secret key as the first argument, not a list of keys. This will cause deserialization failures for existing sessions signed with the old key, leading to invalid signature errors.

findings.title: Inconsistent indentation in signer_kwargs
findings.body: The `signer_kwargs` dictionary is formatted with inconsistent indentation (4 spaces for the opening brace, 12 spaces for the contents). The surrounding code uses 4-space indentation consistently. This breaks local style consistency.

summary.problem: Secret key rotation implementation breaks session deserialization and introduces style inconsistencies.
summary.done_well: The change introduces secret key rotation support via fallback keys, aligning with the PR's intent to enable key rotation.
